product.name: Monoprice Super VGA (SVGA) Monitor Cable 6ft
product.description: Connect your SVGA monitor to your computer using this Super VGA Monitor Cable from Monoprice!This double-shielded cable is designed to handle analog VGA and extended VGA resolutions. It features gold-plated male DE-15 (aka HD-15 or DB-15) connectors on each end for smooth, corrosion-free connections. Each heavy duty connector head includes thumbscrews for securing the plug to a panel connector. It includes ferrite cores at each end, which ensure that EMI and RFI interference will not enter your video system.Warning: This product may contain a chemical known to the State of California to cause cancer, birth defects, or other reproductive harm. For more information, go to www.P65Warnings.ca.gov
